fiber_blindness_verification.claim: SPECTRAL and BETTI on this bundle schema are fiber-blind — they read the field-index graph from indexed bitmaps (vertex_a, vertex_b) only, not the SU(2) quaternion fiber fields (q0..q3).

evidence_for_blindness.reading: SPECTRAL values agree to 4 significant figures despite ⟨P⟩ differing by 2.25× across the deconfinement transition. Confirms SPECTRAL reads topology only, not the gauge field.

evidence_for_fiber_awareness_in_insert_c.reading: The substrate's per-insert curvature differs between the two β configurations. This signal IS fiber-aware — gigi's automatic geometric drift monitoring reads the actual record values during INSERT, not just indexed bitmaps. This is one fiber-aware substrate observable we get for free even without the EXPOSE_GAUGE_AS_BUNDLE bridge ask.

headline_caveats: SPECTRAL on this bundle is NOT the YM mass gap. It is λ₁ of the buckyball line-graph Laplacian (a topology invariant, fiber-blind).
BETTI on this bundle is the topology of the field-index graph (β₀+β₁ = 56 for the line graph). Pure topology.

HOLONOMY around faces requires either (a) a separate faces bundle with edge cycles (face tracing failed in this push due to graph.faces shape mismatch — fixable) or (b) Halcyon-side LATTICE access. Not measured here.
True YM mass-gap reading requires EXPOSE_GAUGE_AS_BUNDLE (the bridge ask) OR a new gauge-aware Laplacian verb. Neither exists today.

What IS measurable today through this bundle path: topology (BETTI), insert-time per-config geometric drift (curvature + confidence), and the bundle exists for any future gauge-aware verbs to operate on.
